dataset.name: Project-AgML/cotton_leaf_disease_classification_bangladesh_2 (config raw, split train)
dataset.splitNote: This is the source dataset's only split: its raw config has no test or validation split. It is not a held-out test set. The model's own training data is unpublished, so overlap cannot be excluded.
dataset.labelSource: ClassLabel feature names read from the parquet file's HuggingFace metadata
dataset.overlapWarning: This dataset's provenance relative to the cotton model's (unnamed) training data is unknown. Treat these numbers as a sanity check, not as field performance.

preprocessing.description: Resize(shorter side 256, bilinear) -> CenterCrop(224) -> ToTensor -> Normalize(mean=[0.485,0.456,0.406], std=[0.229,0.224,0.225])

exclusions.note: Declared exclusions are evaluated and content-hashed like every other image, then omitted from the measured metrics only. They remain in the JSON report and manifest with their reason. No image is deleted, relabelled, or altered.
